title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.34004v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuer

translated_title: RICE-Alpha：基于事件图的可靠性信息校正方法，用于LLM智能体股票预测
translated_abstract: 与股票相关的新闻通过具有时间依赖性的企业事件不断演变，因此只有当事件连续性、信息可用性和转移可靠性都被建模时，历史信息才有价值。现有的基于LLM的金融智能体虽然引入了历史证据，但在时点约束下保留发行方特定的时间脉络，以及识别历史转移何时能为当前预测提供超出当前信息范围的额外信息方面，其支持能力有限。我们提出了RICE-Alpha（基于事件图的可靠性信息校正），这是一个时点股票评分框架，它将具备历史感知能力的多视图基础Alpha与从历史事件延续中推导出的可靠性校准残差校正相分离。一个多层记忆层将新闻解读锚定于时间上合规的发行方特定历史，同时一个类型化事件智能体构建事件状态，其后续关系在发行方（内形成——原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RICE-Alpha框架，通过多层记忆层和类型化事件智能体构建事件图，将历史感知的多视图基础Alpha与基于历史事件延续的可靠性校准残差校正相结合，从而在时点约束下提升LLM智能体的股票预测能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RICE-Alpha, a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that combines a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha with a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from event graphs, improving LLM-agent stock forecasting by modeling event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability.
